claims.statement: The pinned attachment list names JPEG (.jpg/.jpeg), PNG, GIF, WEBP, PDF, HEIC, and HEIF. Extensions are a source format list, not successful decoding, size/page/animation limits, availability in every client, secure handling, or permission to upload private material; no files were uploaded.

The language fragment claims broad language/framework suggestions with especially strong performance for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, Go, C#, and C++, plus database queries, APIs/frameworks, and infrastructure as code. It provides no benchmark, version matrix, security/correctness guarantee, or measured support for this repository.

The billing fragment says code completions and next-edit suggestions are not billed in AI credits, remain unlimited for paid plans, and retain their existing counting mechanism. It does not extend unlimited usage to free plans, all Chat/agent requests, or every cost category; no live billing or entitlement was verified.

The JavaScript instruction supplies only an opening calculateDaysBetweenDates function header with begin and end parameters. The isolated example has no body or closing brace, no date semantics, and no runnable or tested calculation implementation. Source typing instructions were not executed.

The fragment recommends accompanying an image with a chat prompt and illustrates diagram explanation, detailed image description, and error-message interpretation. Examples do not prove output accuracy, permission to transmit an image, or an actual response; no prompt was submitted.

The permissions fragment lists enterprise owners, enterprise billing managers, organization owners, and custom organization/enterprise roles with the corresponding View Organization or View Enterprise Copilot Metrics permission. Listed reader roles are not actual granted access, token scopes, authorization to collect private metrics, or a successful retrieval receipt.
